summary: Static review completed for CareerMatch AI. Laravel/PHP runtime is unavailable in the container, so authenticated HTTP, persistence, OpenRouter, and responsive browser flows could not be executed.

critical.issue: The controller directly indexes $request->user()->apply_configuration['career_match']['weights']; users with a null/empty configuration may trigger an invalid offset/type error instead of returning a score.

minor.issue: OPENROUTER_MODEL has no application-level default. If the environment variable is absent, the service reports missing configuration despite the requested default being specified only in .env.example.

action_items: Guard score configuration with ($request->user()->apply_configuration ?? []) before nested access.
Set the requested model fallback in config/services.php while retaining OPENROUTER_MODEL override.
Run Laravel feature tests and Playwright mobile checks in an environment with PHP, Composer, database, and Vite installed.
critical_code_review_comments: The score endpoint should not assume career_match/weights exists for first-time users.
The configured model default should live in application configuration, not only in the example environment file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Review covered all referenced implementation files and data-testid coverage statically. No valid authenticated credentials file was available; PHP, Composer, and Vite are absent. Re-test runtime flows after environment setup and controller/config fixes.
rca of the issue: Runtime testing was blocked because php/composer/vite are not installed and /app/memory/test_credentials.md is missing. Static RCA: score() dereferences nested nullable JSON without normalizing it; OpenRouter model config reads env without the requested fallback.
